name: Northumbria University

sources.title: Credibility interviews | Northumbria University
topics: course motivation (and why further study if already a graduate)
quotes: Why have you chosen to study in the UK?
Why did you decide to study at Northumbria University?
What motivated you to choose your course of study?
What are your future career goals, and how will this course help you achieve them?
How are you financing your studies?
Where do you plan to live during your studies at Northumbria University?
sources.notes: Fetched. Guidance under each question verbatim: 'You should consider what other countries you looked at and why you chose the UK over them?'; 'Be prepared to discuss the other UK universities you considered and explain in detail why Northumbria University was a better fit for you.'; 'If you've previously completed university studies, be prepared to explain why you're pursuing additional academic work.'; 'You will need to explain how you plan to cover your tuition fees and living expenses while studying in the UK.'; 'they will expect you to have considered your options' (accommodation). UKVI interview: 'Typically, you will be interviewed during your biometrics appointment'; 'conducted by a UKVI staff member in the UK, either via video conference (e.g., Skype), telephone, or face-to-face.' Pre-CAS: 'a Pre-CAS Interview as part of their admissions process to Northumbria University. This interview, conducted within CAS shield, aims to verify that you are a genuine student.' 'If you are unable to answer the questions satisfactorily during this interview, you will not be issued a CAS.' 'If you fail to attend your interview, your visa application will be refused.'

sources.notes: Fetched. 'Some applicants may need to complete a Pre-CAS Interview as part of their admissions process to Northumbria University.' No example questions.

sources.title: Northumbria University: live CAS Shield tenant (northumbria.cas-shield.com)
sources.notes: Probed 8 September 2026: the subdomain answers HTTP 200 with the Enroly CAS Shield sign-in page (random subdomains answer nothing), so the university runs its CAS process through Enroly. CAS Shield interviews follow the themes in Brunel's published policy; whether this university switches the interview on for every Nepali applicant is not stated here.

researcherNotes: Official page gives six verbatim questions with guidance; Pre-CAS interview confirmed inside CAS Shield with a must-pass rule. pathway.northumbria.ac.uk/faq/ was fetched and had no interview content.
